title: This Block Shouldn't Exist

noob.caption: #FFD23F
noob.acting: bright, fast, cheerful cartoon character, impulsive and oblivious, great comic timing

steve.caption: #3FE0D0
steve.acting: calm, low, dry and deadpan; a practical survivor who rarely raises his voice

patch.caption: #B6F0FF
patch.acting: calm, literal, slightly too quiet; announces disasters politely

movie_note: Movie Episode 4 (the creator's notes, 2026-11-26; story/movie/ep04_shots.md): picks up Ep3 v3's frozen dragon; the block tears off it, the dragon is sealed in glitch crystal; the respawn tether shows the rule; REALITY 92 -> 89 -> 85 on the two respawns; Patch comes out of the portal; the twist in silence. The original takes for the original lines (from the voice cache); new takes only for the added lines and 'I touched it!'.

music.note: light comedy for the touches: out dead on each shatter and for '...It grew.', back on the beat
Patch: curious, a little mysterious; cut dead the frame after 'No.'
'From a world that got deleted': a deep swell and one high, sad note, ringing into Episode 5

sfx.note: the eye dilates: a digital stutter

events.note: Ep3's last frame goes on: the dragon frozen in the sky over the spawn pad, the Noob lying on its neck, Steve below on the grey pad looking up, the portal flickering behind, the kicked cobblestones hanging; one last violent missing-texture shudder runs through the dragon (the checkerboard carries on across the cut)
a glowing checkerboard cube rips loose from its chest in a burst of magenta sparks; the dragon snaps back to its dark scales; the jolt shakes the Noob's grip loose

the cube drops onto the big blue stage in front of the portal pad and lands with a thud, then lifts and hovers a hand above it; the Noob slides off the neck, tumbles and belly-flops on the round spawn pad beside it

the dragon's fate: the glitch crystal that held the frozen players grows over it, wingtips first, and seals it where it hangs, a frozen statue in the sky; Steve looks up at it; the Noob bounces up onto his feet and sees the cube

events.name: noob_secret
events.direction_text: [amazed, thrilled, whispering loudly] A secret block!
events.note: the original take; he crouches to it, eyes wide
the Noob reaches for it; Steve steps to the edge of the grey pad, pickaxe up, waving his free hand

events.name: steve_touch
events.text: It fell off the dragon. Don't touch it.
events.solo_text: It fell off the dragon. Don't touch it.
events.note: the original take; leaning forward off the grey pad

events.name: noob_touched
events.note: the published take (a wrong-sounding voice): kept in its scene so the other lines' takes stay exactly as published, never placed; replaced by noob_touched2
the Noob pokes it: the finger stops on the block for two frames, a pink flash
he bursts into his parts (head, arms, torso, legs) that tumble and bounce off the blue stage; one small dark cube drifts away from where he died, off-centre

the cyan respawn beam on the spawn pad; a magenta-cyan glitch tether arcs from the pad's ring into the cube for half a second, and the cube swells 0.45 -> 0.85 m (waist-high) with a shockwave; REALITY 92 -> 89; the Noob pops up (squash and stretch), fist-pump

events.name: noob_touched2
events.note: a new take in the Noob's own voice (the creator, 2026-11-26: the published take sounded like Patch's voice)
Steve stares at the bigger cube, then at the Noob; the music drops out

events.name: steve_grew
events.note: the original take; deadpan, in silence

events.name: noob_again
events.note: the original take
before Steve can grab him, the Noob karate-chops the cube (Steve lunges a step, too late)
the same burst, bigger; one dark cube drifts away
the respawn; a stronger tether into the cube, which swells to 1.45 m (shoulder-high, casting a pink shadow over the blue stage); REALITY 89 -> 85; the Noob pops up and winds up a third swing

behind them the portal flickers; a small blue pixel-warp tears at its surface and Patch squeezes out, steadies with a little bob, then zips across the gap (banking into the move, braking with a counter-tilt) and stops between the Noob's raised fist and the cube

events.name: patch_stop
events.direction_text: [calm, quiet, polite] Please stop doing that.
events.note: the original take; eyelid flat (annoyed)
Steve jumps back into a guard, pickaxe raised, eyes darting between Patch and the cube; the Noob hops back and points with both hands

events.name: noob_cube
events.note: the original take; mouth wide open

events.name: patch_name
events.direction_text: [calm, literal] I'm Patch. I find glitches.
events.note: added line: Patch is named on screen (the creator's notes: the name was never said)
Patch glides a metre and a half to the front right (a clear line to the cube, the Noob safely behind) and sweeps a cyan scan cone over the huge cube; little data bars flicker beside it

events.name: patch_feed
events.text: It's feeding on your respawn loop.
events.direction_text: [calm, literal] It's feeding on your respawn loop.
events.solo_text: It's feeding on your respawn loop.
events.note: added line (the creator's notes): what the tether showed

events.name: patch_grows
events.text: It grows every time you come back.
events.direction_text: [calm, literal] It grows every time you come back.
events.note: the original take

events.name: noob_helping
events.note: the original take
Steve lowers his pickaxe a little, blinks, his shoulders drop; he looks from the Noob to Patch and back

events.name: steve_no
events.note: the original take; the music cut dead right after it

silence; Patch turns sharply to the Noob: its eye dilates, flickers with white scanlines and freezes; the camera pushes in to a two-shot (the Noob left, Patch right, the frozen dragon and the portal in the sky between them)

events.name: patch_know
events.note: the original take; quiet

events.name: noob_doyou
events.note: the original take; the smile gone
Patch drifts half a metre closer, its eye pulsing dim

events.name: patch_deleted
events.text: From a world that got deleted.
events.direction_text: [quiet, ominous] From a world that got deleted.
events.note: the original take; the machine sound softer on it
hold on the Noob's stunned face, Steve's alarmed glance at Patch; the low swell rings on into Episode 5
